Title: Cost of a card that cost X will use the paid cost if is referenced in the future

Messages.Author: Coyote
Messages.Body:
I understand that this rule:

www.vekn.net/forum/rules-questions/75987-question-about-khobar-towers-al-khubar#82606

When a card that cost X is played, the value of X is set to the amount paid and used for future references. And this rule is used anywhere the cost of the card would be relevant.

It was ruled for Khobar Towers, Al-Khubar
I understand that it would be used also for [SER] Revelation of Ecstasy (and any other card referencing a cost of a card)
And that means that if I play several Reanimated Corpses it is going to be a hell, but I will have to keep the record of each Corpse I had played.

Correct?
This is a hell as there is no default method to do it. But if it has to be done, it has to be done.

Warning: Spoiler!

Name: Khobar Towers, Al-Khubar
[FN:R2, LotN:PS, 25th:1, POD:DTC]
Cardtype: Master
Clan: Ministry
Cost: 2 pool
Unique location.
Lock during your unlock phase to remove a ready minion you control from the game and gain X pool, where X is their capacity or cost.
Artist: Michael Gaydos

Name: Revelation of Ecstasy
[LotN:C/PS4, POD:DTC]
Cardtype: Action
Discipline: Serpentis
+1 stealth action.
[ser]  Lock a ready minion controlled by your prey.
[SER] As above, and put 1 corruption counter on the target minion. If the number of your corruption counters on the minion equals or exceeds their capacity or cost, you can burn those counters to steal the target minion.
Artist: Jim Di Bartolo

Name: Reanimated Corpse
[LoB:C, HttB:PSam3]
Cardtype: Ally
Cost: X blood
Discipline: Thanatosis
Zombie with 2 life. 2 strength, 2 bleed.
[thn] Put X pathos counters on this corpse when it enters play. During your unlock phase, burn 1 pathos counter. Remove the corpse from the game if it has no pathos counters. The corpse can play combat cards that require basic Fortitude [for] as a vampire.
[THN] As above, but put 2 additional pathos counters on the corpse.
Artist: Roel Wielinga

Messages.Author: Legion
Messages.Body: It works the same way as in all other card games. If you need additional accessories bring them with you (e.g. additional set of counters or set of dice)

Name: Charisma

Put this card on a ready vampire. Recruit ally actions cost this vampire 1 fewer blood or pool.

Messages.Author: Coyote
Messages.Body:
Ankha Will confirm it, but I think that the cost of the card is not changed. Just how much you pay for it.
So an Ally costing 1 pool recruited with Charisma you would pay 0, but the cost is still 1.
